primary_market: Festive & Ethnic Home Decor Market in Urban India (Tier-1 and Metro Cities)
target_buyers: Urban homeowners seeking traditional or fusion festive tabletop decor
Corporate procurement teams purchasing bulk festive gifts for employees and clients
Wedding planners and event decorators looking for ethnic table centerpieces
Interior designers specializing in traditional Indian or vintage decor styles
Boutique store curators looking for authentic metal handicraft items
selling_channels: Handicraft e-commerce marketplaces (e.g., Etsy India, Jaypore, Craftsvilla, Amazon Karigar)
Festive pop-up exhibitions and handicraft fairs (e.g., Dilli Haat, Saras Mela)
B2B wholesale supply to corporate gifting aggregators
Social commerce platforms (Instagram Store, WhatsApp Business catalog)
Consignment sales through local boutique home decor stores
reasoning: The peacock motif is a timeless Indian symbol representing grace, beauty, and auspiciousness, making it highly desirable during festive seasons like Diwali, Navratri, and weddings. Metal casting with an antique brass finish gives the product a premium, handcrafted heritage appeal, while the functional glass tealight insert offers modern utility and safety. This combination of traditional art, utility, and affordable luxury makes it ideal for urban home decor, gifting, and hospitality spaces.
market_opportunities: Create bundled festive hampers combining the holder with eco-friendly handmade scented tealight candles
Offer bulk customization and set options (e.g., pair of peacock holders) tailored for wedding return gifts
Target pre-festive B2B corporate gifting catalogs 2–3 months prior to Diwali for volume orders
Collaborate with fair-trade export platforms to tap into the Indian diaspora market in North America and Europe
